keySentence: Real courage means doing right when afraid.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim found the pirates on the ship. One was sleeping. The other one chased Jim! Real courage means doing right when afraid.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim discovered one pirate asleep and another awake on the ship. The awake pirate spotted Jim and chased him across the deck! Jim used his knowledge of the ship to escape and fight back. All the skills he learned during the voyage helped him now. Real courage means doing right when afraid. Jim's hard work and preparation finally paid off.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: When Jim boarded the Hispaniola, he found one pirate unconscious from drinking too much rum. Unfortunately, the other pirate was wide awake and immediately spotted the young intruder. A dangerous chase began across the deck of the rocking ship. Jim scrambled up the ropes and rigging, using every skill he had learned during the voyage. Real courage means doing right when afraid. However, the pirate was bigger and stronger than Jim in every way. Because Jim had studied the ship's layout so carefully, he knew hiding spots the pirate did not. In the end, Jim's preparation and quick thinking gave him the advantage he needed to survive.
facts.Word cards: real courage = 진짜 용기 / when afraid = 두려울 때 / doing right = 옳은 일 / moment = 순간
